verdict.rationale: Algolia's first-party docs say it applies custom ranking on top of searchable attributes and uses non-textual factors such as criteria and geolocation, not just text matching. Rules can override relevance for business needs like promotions or repositioning products, and Merchandising Studio and Personalization add boosting and per-user ranking. A community report notes that each sort option needs a duplicate index, which inflates record counts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ranking on popularity, recency, or margin attributes; detail on how custom ranking criteria are configured; independent hands-on confirmation of business-signal ranking.
